result.note: Tests the named framework of India–South Korea ties set by the April 2026 roadmap; the Jeju Forum keynote was still a plan, so it is skipped.

questions.prompt: In April 2026, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's state visit to India set a 2026 to 2030 roadmap for which framework of India–South Korea relations?
questions.explain: The April 2026 state visit set a 2026 to 2030 roadmap for the two countries' Special Strategic Partnership. In June 2026, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar's visit to South Korea built on it, with talks covering semiconductors, critical minerals, AI and a review of the India-Korea CEPA.
questions.source: which set a 2026 to 2030 roadmap for the two countries' Special Strategic Partnership
